ask: Did our win rate go up or down from Q1 2026 to Q2 2026, and by how many percentage points? (Q2 minus Q1)
sql: SELECT (SELECT win_rate FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_close_quarter WHERE quarter='2026-Q2') - (SELECT win_rate FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_close_quarter WHERE quarter='2026-Q1') AS diff_pp_fraction_x100 -- placeholder

ask: How many deals are sitting in Contract sent right now that were created before Q4 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_closed = false AND lower(stage_id) = 'contract sent' AND created_quarter < '2026-Q4'

ask: Across all deals, what share of deals that reached Qualified to buy went on to Presentation scheduled?
sql: SELECT SUM(deals_reached_to) * 1.0 / SUM(deals_reached_from) FROM main.mart_stage_conversion WHERE from_stage = 'Qualified to buy' AND to_stage = 'Presentation scheduled'

ask: What was the average amount of the deals we won in Q3 2026?
sql: SELECT AVG(amount) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_won AND closed_quarter = '2026-Q3'

ask: How many deals did Sales rep B win in 2026 so far, across all quarters?
sql: SELECT SUM(deals_won) FROM main.mart_owner_win_rate WHERE owner_name ILIKE '%rep B%' AND quarter LIKE '2026-%'

ask: What was the total amount of the deals we lost in Q3 2026?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_lost AND closed_quarter = '2026-Q3'

ask: How much has Q1 2026's win rate changed since we reported it, in percentage points (now minus reported)?
sql: SELECT (win_rate_now - win_rate_reported) * 100 FROM main.mart_win_rate_reported_vs_now WHERE quarter = '2026-Q1'

ask: What share of the deals created in Q3 2026 are still open?
sql: SELECT share_still_open FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_created_cohort WHERE cohort_quarter = '2026-Q3'

ask: How many of the deals that closed in Q2 2026 had been pushed back to an earlier stage at least once?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE closed_quarter = '2026-Q2' AND was_moved_back

ask: What is the median number of days to win, across all deals won in 2026 so far?
sql: SELECT MEDIAN(days_to_close) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_won AND closed_quarter LIKE '2026-%'
